description: A DevOps engineer against a mid-level Java backend role: infrastructure overlaps, product code does not.

expectations.rationale: Docker, CI/CD, Git and microservices-adjacent language transfer; Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and SQL do not, and the role's core is writing backend services. The original 20-60 band assumed a shared vocabulary of four terms was half a match. Corrected in CALIBRATION.md.
